title: Chapter 112: Sounds Familiar
html:
Doctor Gao seemed to have his own reservations. “I’m afraid Men Nan might not be able to survive until tonight; his condition is getting worse.”

Men Nan maintained his strange, bowed posture. His eyes darted about, but he said nothing.

“We have no better option.” Chen Ge understood the doctor’s concern. “His condition is nothing like Wang Xin’s, so I can’t treat it the same way. If you trust me, let me inspect his apartment tonight. I may find something. First, though, I have another question.”

Chen Ge approached Men Nan and slowly passed a hand above his head and along his spine.

“What are you doing?” Doctor Gao was confounded.

“Have you noticed that he keeps his head lowered whether he’s walking or speaking? It looks as though something is pressing against his skull.” Chen Ge had noticed earlier but found no chance to ask. “Men Nan, isn’t that posture uncomfortable?”

Reminded by Chen Ge, Doctor Gao patted Men Nan on his back. “Are you still feeling uncomfortable?”

Men Nan waved the question away without raising his head. Standing in the crowd had exhausted him, and he looked ready to lose control. Doctor Gao quickly guided him to a darker, quieter place to rest.

His eye movements aren’t normal. He keeps scanning the space around him and looking upward, as though trying to see something above his head.

Chen Ge studied Men Nan’s shadow. A natural hunch would have curved his spine, but the young man’s back remained straight; only his neck bowed. It truly looked as though something heavy sat atop his head.

Why does washing his hair trigger that dream?

The black phone remained silent. Chen Ge let it be. A special visitor was a bonus, not something he could force. After he admitted two groups into the attraction, Men Nan’s condition improved. Doctor Gao’s skill was obvious; under his care, the young man calmed from the edge of collapse.

Doctor Gao brought Men Nan back. They had reached a decision. “Eight tonight. We’ll meet you at Hai Ming Apartments.”

“All right.” The black phone vibrated in Chen Ge’s pocket. “Let him sleep normally tonight. I’ll keep watch.”

“I’ll accompany you.” Doctor Gao thanked Chen Ge before leaving with Men Nan.

Another strange case.Chen Ge was beginning to understand special visitors. They were not ghosts, but people caught along the boundary between two worlds. As soon as they left, he checked the black phone.

“The second special visitor has departed. Your actions have unlocked mission information! Hidden Trial Mission unlocked: A Room of Three.

“A Room of Three (One-Star Scream Factor): Arrive at Hai Ming Apartments before midnight and discover the cause of the special visitor’s condition.

“Mission Venue: Hai Ming Apartments, Room 303.

“Mission Hint: He came from the Third Sick Hall.

“Would you like to accept this mission? Warning: The Trial Mission will remain available for twenty-four hours. If you fail to accept it within that period, the mission will be forfeited and this scenario will remain locked forever.”

At first, the Hidden Mission barely interested him. Then he read the hint.

It’s related to the Third Sick Hall? He came from the Third Sick Hall? Men Nan has been treated inside the Third Sick Hall?

On rereading the details, he noticed an odd pattern: the number three appeared repeatedly. Is that a coincidence? What does A Room of Three actually mean?

Perhaps two ghosts inhabited Men Nan, making three beings in one body. Or perhaps the title referred to Chen Ge, Doctor Gao, and Men Nan sharing the room. Whatever the answer, its connection to a Three-Star Scenario demanded caution. He memorized every detail before pocketing the phone.

He asked Xu Wan to sell tickets while he played the ghost in Murder by Midnight. The morning passed without incident. At lunch, rather than join her at the canteen, he went alone to the park offices.

After discovering Director Luo’s daughter, Chen Ge had questions for the man himself. He took the elevator to the top floor and found the office door open; Director Luo apparently disliked enclosed rooms. At Chen Ge’s knock, he emerged carrying several reports.

“Director Luo, do you have time for a few questions?”

Director Luo put the reports down. “Problems with the underground parking lot?”

“No, this is something else.” Chen Ge placed Luo Ruoyu’s bracelet and his parents’ note on the desk. “I found these beside a support column in the underground parking lot.”

“What do you want to know?” Director Luo recognized the bracelet. “Many of her toys are hidden in quiet corners around the park. I placed them there myself.”

“Why would you do that?”

“They were my daughter’s favorites. I left them throughout the park so she wouldn’t feel lonely if she ever returned.”

“Then did you place other things alongside the toys, like this?” Chen Ge pushed the bloodied note to Director Luo.

Director Luo shook his head after looking at it twice. “I have no recollection of this; it wasn’t me.”

The answer disappointed Chen Ge. He had assumed New Century Park’s director might know something about his parents’ disappearance. But Director Luo did not even realize his own daughter had returned. Chen Ge’s parents had kept many secrets.

“Then, I’m sorry for disturbing you.” Chen Ge picked up the note and prepared to leave.

“Wait a minute!” Director Luo stood up slowly and signaled for Chen Ge to show him the note. “This is your father’s handwriting, isn’t it?”

“Yes. You recognize it?” Most people paid little attention to another person’s handwriting.

“The Third Sick Hall…” Director Luo read the words again. “Shortly before your parents disappeared, I heard them mention this place.”
